messages:
taylor: Quick heads-up: the /jobs/run API docs show `rate_limit.window_ms` as a string in curl example (`"60000"`) but as an integer in the Python/TS SDK snippets (60000). Runtime expects an integer ms value. Can we standardize?

noah: Thanks for catching this. Runtime validation requires number (integer). The string example slipped in during an earlier example clean-up. Recommend updating curl and example JSON payloads to integers and adding a short migration note.

anya: Agreed. Small plan: update the API ref examples (curl, python, ts) to use `"rate_limit": {"window_ms": 60000, "max_requests": 120}` (integers). Add migration guidance: if you previously used string values, cast to int.

taylor: I'll open a docs PR with corrected examples and add a one-liner for each SDK: Python `int(window)` and TS `Number(window)`. Also will add a unit check in the examples harness asserting `typeof window_ms === 'number'` for JS.

noah: Also note OpenAPI currently documents `window_ms` as `string` in components. We should update the schema to `integer` so generated clients are consistent. Devex: will this break any downstream generated code?

anya: Devex check: changing OpenAPI schema from string->integer will update client types; most customers won't be broken but some ad-hoc scripts that passed strings may need tweaks. Let's mark the schema change in the changelog and include a short migration note in the docs PR.

noah: Good. One small ask: show an example that accepts either shape for a short transitional period in the migration note: example JS validation `const w = typeof body.rate_limit.window_ms === 'string' ? Number(body.rate_limit.window_ms) : body.rate_limit.window_ms;`.

 taylor: Added that snippet and the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7788. Preview deployed.

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR 7788 preview -> https://deploy-preview-7788--docs.redwood.ai. Rendering check passed.

anya: Left an inline comment to add a short sentence about accepting milliseconds (not seconds) to prevent unit confusion. Many folks send 60 instead of 60000.

 taylor: Added the unit clarification and a small table showing examples (60 -> 60000). Also added CI lint check for example JSON schemas.

noah: LGTM from infra side. Merge when ready and file the OpenAPI schema PR after merge so codegens pick up the integer type.

 taylor: Merged. Will open OpenAPI change and ping devex + release-notes. Thanks :rocket:
